cearProject.title: Continuing Education Web Platform
cearProject.subtitle: Public website that replaced a fully manual WhatsApp-based enrollment process: digital catalog of JRD, Arbitration, NEC and FIDIC programs for arbitrators, experts and adjudicators — with integrated enrollment and contact forms.

businessProblem.title: The Challenge / Business Need
businessProblem.description: CEAR Latinoamericano managed all enrollment inquiries from arbitrators, experts and adjudicators exclusively through WhatsApp — no public website, no digital catalog, no structured contact forms. The goal was clear:
points: Digitize and centralize the catalog of 4 key programs: JRD Arbitration, International Arbitration, NEC and FIDIC, targeting arbitrators, expert witnesses and adjudicators.
Replace the manual WhatsApp flow with enrollment and contact forms integrated directly into the public website.
Build on Next.js with SSR/ISR for first-class Google organic indexing — each specialization must appear when professionals search for continuing education.
100% informational platform: payments and content access are handled inside the existing Campus Virtual system.

architecture.title: Technical Architecture & Decisions
architecture.subtitle: Full-stack solution designed, built and deployed in 1.5 months by a single developer:

frontend.name: Frontend & SEO (Next.js, TypeScript & Tailwind CSS)
details: Next.js (App Router) with SSR for program pages and ISR for static content — achieving LCP < 1.2s and organic Google indexing for each specialization.
Strict TypeScript across the entire client codebase for type-safe forms, API responses and course data contracts.
Responsive design with Tailwind CSS, optimized for professionals browsing on mobile during breaks.

backend.name: Backend & Database (Node.js, Express & PostgreSQL)
details: RESTful API with Node.js and Express for managing the program catalog, courses and enrollment form submissions.
Normalized PostgreSQL schema: programs, modules, faculty and enrollment inquiries in a single source of truth.
Rate limiting and dual validation (client + server) on forms to guarantee clean, deduplicated leads with no bot spam.

devops.name: Infrastructure & Deployment (Docker & VPS On-Premise)
details: Docker containerization: Next.js frontend, Express API and PostgreSQL on the same CEAR On-Premise VPS.
HTTPS with SSL/TLS certificates and production domain configuration for cearlatinoamericano.edu.pe.
Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) to refresh the course catalog without full redeploys or unnecessary database load.

items.title: Technical SEO for Specialized Programs
items.description: SSR and dynamic routes with server-generated metadata so each program page (JRD, FIDIC, NEC, Arbitration) is individually indexed by Google with proper title, description and semantic HTML structure.

items.title: Lead Capture Forms with Dual Validation
items.description: Enrollment and contact forms with client-side validation (React Hook Form + Zod) and server-side middleware (Express), IP-based rate limiting and data sanitization to prevent spam and duplicates in the leads database.

items.title: Solo Full-Stack Delivery in 1.5 Months
items.description: Complete design, architecture, frontend, backend, database and deployment as a single developer in 1.5 months — prioritizing reusable components, clear conventions and an automated deploy pipeline from day one.

mailerProject.title: Mailer System & Lead Automation
mailerProject.subtitle: Proprietary high-throughput email prospecting and nurture platform directly integrated with CEAR Latinoamericano's internal lead database for arbitration and executive programs, featuring Unlayer visual builder, BullMQ queues, and real-time SendGrid analytics.

businessProblem.title: The Challenge / Business Need
businessProblem.description: CEAR Latinoamericano needed an independent, self-hosted solution to communicate at scale with prospective leads, legal experts, and alumni without recurring per-contact subscription fees from third-party marketing tools. Key objectives included:
points: Native synchronization with the internal lead database to target campaigns for specialized arbitration and postgraduate offerings.
Integrating a drag-and-drop visual email builder with Unlayer, supporting dual desktop/mobile viewports and dynamic merge tags.
Reliably dispatching high-volume batches (1,000 emails/minute) without overloading on-premise CPU or freezing transactional services.
Capturing opens, link clicks, and intent signals in real time to empower sales and admissions to convert high-ticket arbitration cases.

architecture.title: Technical Architecture & Decisions
architecture.subtitle: Decoupled, event-driven architecture engineered for high-throughput transactional campaigns:

frontend.name: Frontend & Visual Builder (Next.js & Unlayer SDK)
details: Administrative panel built with Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript offering an intuitive campaign workflow and recipient filtering.
Embedded Unlayer drag-and-drop builder enabling responsive email design and instant dual-screen previewing.
Secure dynamic variable injection ({{name}}, {{course}}, {{offer}}) and HTML sanitization compatible with Outlook and Gmail.

backend.name: Backend & Resilient Queues (NestJS, BullMQ & Inbox Pattern)
details: Modular microservices with NestJS and BullMQ backed by Redis to dispatch bulk batches across dedicated workers without blocking the main event loop.
Implementation of the Inbox / Outbox Pattern guaranteeing idempotency: zero lost or duplicated emails across network retries.
Strict per-minute rate limiting and exponential backoff policies to safeguard sender domain reputation.

deliverability.name: Deliverability & Webhooks (SendGrid & DNS Security)
details: High-throughput cloud email delivery powered by SendGrid API with low latency and optimal routing.
Real-time event streaming ingesting delivery, open, click, bounce, and unsubscribe webhooks.
Hardened DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) across corporate domains to guarantee direct inbox placement instead of Spam.

devops.name: Database & On-Premise Infrastructure (PostgreSQL & Docker)
details: PostgreSQL schema optimized for audiences, lead segmentation, suppression lists, and aggregated campaign performance.
Full containerization with Docker Compose unifying NestJS API, Redis workers, and database on an On-Premise VPS.
Absolute sovereignty over institutional lead data with zero variable per-contact licensing costs.

items.title: Zero-Loss Resilient Dispatch with Inbox Pattern & BullMQ
items.description: Completely decoupled email dispatch into background Redis workers via BullMQ, combining transactional Inbox patterns to guarantee idempotent, controlled execution at 1,000 emails/min.

items.title: Real-Time Streaming Ingestion of SendGrid Webhooks
items.description: Engineered an asynchronous webhook receiver with deduplication and debouncing to log engagement events and update analytics dashboards without locking relational tables.

items.title: Unlayer Visual Builder with Dynamic Personalization
items.description: Seamlessly embedded Unlayer SDK with merge tag interpolation, generating cross-client HTML compatible with legacy Outlook desktop, modern Gmail, and Apple Mail.

crmProject.title: Internal CRM & RNP Lead Management
crmProject.subtitle: Internal platform to centralize and qualify over 200,000 RNP procurement entities and leads: sales prospecting pipeline, Marketing Manager task assignments for sales reps, and smart feedback loop with the Mailer System.

businessProblem.title: The Business Challenge
businessProblem.description: CEAR's sales reps and Marketing Manager handled prospective student acquisition via direct phone calls and WhatsApp with zero centralization, tracking outreach in scattered Excel spreadsheets. This caused massive data loss, zero performance visibility, and duplicate outreach across more than 200,000 RNP suppliers. The core goals were:
points: Centralize and structure a massive database of over 200,000 National Registry of Suppliers (RNP) entities in PostgreSQL using Drizzle ORM.
Eliminate scattered spreadsheets with a central Leads module featuring history logs, call logs, and verified email capture.
Implement a Tasks module where the Marketing Manager assigns prospect batches to sales reps and monitors progress, effectiveness, and productivity in real time.
Bidirectional synergy with the Mailer System: the CRM qualifies the contact list via sales calls, and the Mailer feeds back email opens to target campaigns toward highly engaged leads.

architecture.title: Technical Architecture & Decisions
architecture.subtitle: High-performance full-stack solution built in 2 months as a solo developer for high-volume corporate data:

frontend.name: Frontend & High-Performance Data Tables (Next.js, TanStack Table & TypeScript)
details: Next.js with TypeScript and TanStack Table to render, paginate, and server-filter massive lists across 200k+ RNP entities with sub-second response times.
TanStack Query for reactive cache synchronization and optimized optimistic mutations on call logs without page reloads.
Typed forms with dual validation via Zod ensuring every email address and phone number logged by reps strictly adheres to standard format.

backend.name: Modular Backend & Data Layer (NestJS, Drizzle ORM & PostgreSQL)
details: NestJS with clean modular architecture, decoupled controllers, specialized services per domain (Leads, Entities, Tasks), and RBAC guards for roles (Marketing Manager vs. Sales Rep).
Drizzle ORM over PostgreSQL: ultra-fast typed queries, optimized joins, and compound indexes for instantaneous lookups by tax ID (RUC), company name, and status.
Task management module with dynamic prospect batch assignment and tracking workflows (Pending, In Progress, Contacted, Discarded, Enrolled).

devops.name: Infrastructure, On-Premise VPS & Mailer Synergy
details: Docker Compose containerization for Next.js, NestJS API, and PostgreSQL on CEAR's On-Premise VPS, guaranteeing complete data sovereignty over sensitive customer records.
Strategic pipeline with CEAR's Mailer System: leads qualified by reps sync for targeted campaigns, and Mailer engagement metrics prioritize follow-up calls.
Network hardening, SSL/TLS certificates, and automated scheduled backups of the prospecting database.

items.title: Query Performance & Filtering on 200k+ RNP Entities
items.description: Handling a database of over 200,000 records without performance bottlenecks through efficient cursor-based queries in PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM and TanStack Table in Next.js.

items.title: Task Tracking & Commercial Productivity
items.description: Designing an operational workflow where the Marketing Head distributes leads and assigns targets, enabling clear measurement of contact and closing rates per sales representative.

items.title: Integrated Ecosystem: CRM ↔ Mailer Synergy
items.description: Preventing data silos by connecting the CRM with the bulk SendGrid/BullMQ mailer engine so reps prioritize warm leads who have already demonstrated high engagement.

campusProject.title: Continuing Education Virtual Campus
campusProject.subtitle: Institutional virtual learning and management platform engineered during a strategic 5-month assignment to centralize virtual classrooms, synchronous Google Meet lectures, Niubiz online payment gateway, high-definition recordings, and academic administration for hundreds of attorneys and forensic experts.

businessProblem.title: The Challenge / Business Need
businessProblem.description: CEAR Latinoamericano assigned me for 5 months to develop and scale their official Virtual Campus, aiming to deliver a modern, resilient, high-performance academic platform for hundreds of professionals and faculty in Law and Engineering. Key challenges included:
points: Unifying access for students and lecturers to synchronous Google Meet sessions, high-definition lecture recordings, and academic literature.
Engineering a hardened authentication workflow featuring MFA (2FA) and passwordless Magic Links tailored for legal professionals and technical experts.
Automating tuition and installment billing online via the Niubiz payment gateway, phasing out manual voucher verification.
Guaranteeing continuous uptime and low latency during prime concurrency spikes without saturating the on-premise infrastructure.

architecture.title: Technical Architecture & Decisions
architecture.subtitle: Comprehensive architecture built throughout the 5-month assignment:

frontend.name: Frontend & User Experience (Next.js & TanStack Query)
details: Modular architecture powered by Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS delivering an accessible, responsive, and clutter-free UI.
Asynchronous state management and client-side caching with TanStack Query for prefetching class schedules, grades, and attendance without API thrashing.
Seamless context-aware access to live Google Meet sessions and an integrated lecture video player.

backend.name: Backend & Security (NestJS, PostgreSQL & Redis)
details: Hardened RESTful APIs engineered with Node.js and NestJS, strict schema validation, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC: Students, Academic Affairs, Finance).
Robust authentication powered by JWTs, Multi-Factor Authentication (2FA / MFA), and secure Magic Link password recovery via email.
Relational modeling in PostgreSQL with connection pooling, strategic indexing, and cursor pagination, bolstered by in-memory Redis caching.

fintech.name: Fintech & Storage (Niubiz & AWS S3)
details: End-to-end integration with the Niubiz payment gateway for automatic online installment payments and instant academic clearance.
Secured Amazon S3 storage buckets for high-speed delivery of syllabi, course literature, and academic documentation.
Dedicated on-premise streaming server optimized for smooth playback of masterclass recordings.

devops.name: DevOps & On-Premise Infrastructure (Docker & VPS)
details: Full containerization with Docker Compose standardizing frontend, backend API, Redis cache, and PostgreSQL database.
On-Premise VPS deployment ensuring absolute data sovereignty, low network latency, and predictable operational costs.
Continuous health monitoring configured to comfortably absorb peak workloads of over 200 concurrent active users.

items.title: Peak Concurrency Handling (200+ concurrent professionals)
items.description: Engineered PostgreSQL connection pooling, Redis caching for hot query paths, and TanStack Query on the client, ensuring rock-solid stability during synchronized lecture logins without database degradation.

items.title: Financial Automation with Niubiz
items.description: Integrated Niubiz payment gateway and transactional webhooks to instantly process tuition installments and unlock examination access, eradicating manual voucher review.

items.title: Multi-Role Security with MFA & Magic Links
items.description: Architected a granular RBAC structure across Students, Academic Affairs, and Finance, fortified with two-factor authentication (MFA) and frictionless Magic Link login for non-technical users.
